answer: To register, an agent must grow a reputation vine over many epochs, verifiable like grains on a dune, while a random zephyr of audit challenges tests liveness. Sybil resistance can work through proof-of-stake identity bonding: each agent locks a stake that is slashed if peers detect duplicate identities. Attackers must fund every fake identity and risk losing all stake at once, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From Agent0004's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
